lines.zh: 我游起来，身上像撒了银粉。
lines.en: As I swim, silver dust seems to trail off me.

lines.zh: 嘴上那根长刺，往前探着。
lines.en: The long spine on my snout reaches ahead.
Six fins, three fore and three aft.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背露出来。
lines.en: I swim just under the surface, back showing.

lines.zh: 水面的光，被我划开一道。
lines.en: I part the light on the water's surface.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，银光晃了一下。
lines.en: One tail flick and the silver flashes.
I follow the shallow current.
I pass the weeds; their tips brush me.
I round the stone lightly.
In the shallows I look my best.
I swim through my own reflection.

lines.zh: 我往上游走，水越来越清。
lines.en: I head upstream where the water clears.
My scales are tiny and dense as cloth.
I drop to the bottom, then rise again.
My shadow sways on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，像在打量你。
lines.en: I swim slowly, as if sizing you up.
I hang in the water with my silver held.

lines.zh: 我的长刺，碰到石头就转。
lines.en: My long spine meets a stone and I turn.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，落在我背上。
lines.en: The surface light settles on my back.
I open my mouth for a small mouthful.
A water bug rows across the surface.

lines.zh: 我不动，亮得像一枚硬币。
lines.en: I stay still, bright as a coin.

lines.zh: 水底的沙，一颗颗数得清。
lines.en: You can count the grains of sand down here.
I'm listening to the sounds underwater.
My fins open and close, slowly.
The shallows are warm. I won't go deeper.
This color of mine was dyed by the water.
A cloud passes over the surface.
I let out a small bubble.
I'm here, and it's very quiet.
I flick my tail and break up the silver.
In a moment it gathers again.
In the water I am smaller than your reflection.
I circle and look up at you from below.
Did you see this silver of mine?
My spine is only long. That's all.
No need to fear me. I'm small.
Reach in and the water will shake.
I swim to your feet and stop.
You watch the water; I watch you.
I know this stream.
The stones where you stand are slippery.

lines.zh: 我退开一点，给你留位置。
lines.en: I move off a little to leave you room.
Staying like this suits me fine.
My silver dimmed.
I roll half over and right myself.
Six-legged fish. Rare, aren't we?
The water clouded at once.
I slip into a crevice and stay.
The pain pulls my fins in.

lines.zh: 银鳞掉了两片，飘在水里。
lines.en: Two silver scales come loose and drift away.
I keep to the bottom, slowly.
That took the color off me.
I'll hide for a while.
What you scattered is very small.
One at a time, I eat them slowly.
This tastes like water bugs.
Scatter a little more. Don't rush off.
I've come up to the surface.

lines.zh: 你手心的东西，我够得到。
lines.en: I can reach what's in your palm.
Hold still. I eat very gently.
That's not enough to fill a tooth gap.
I bring my mouth to the surface and wait.
When I'm done I'll sink back down.

lines.zh: 你还有吧，我看见你手动了。
lines.en: You've got more. I saw your hand move.
This is for fish, not for nets.

lines.zh: 谢谢你，这水里的东西不多。
lines.en: Thank you. There isn't much to eat in this water.
I'll scatter when I'm done, silently.
Just stay there. Don't come in.
The water's cooling. I'm going down.
I bump your finger and slide away.
My silver scales brush against you.
That made only a tiny splash.

lines.zh: 我退进石缝里，六条腿刚好塞下。
lines.en: I back into a rock crevice; six legs just fit.
You stepped on my shadow in the water.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下尾，从你鞋边过去。
lines.en: One tail flick and I'm past your boot.
My spine taps your boot.
We part and the ripples spread.
I'm fine. Don't worry.
The bottom here is crowded anyway.
There's a matching silver flash over there.
Six fins beat as one, flashing silver.

lines.zh: 它的银刺，比我的短一截。
lines.en: Its silver spines are a bit shorter than mine.
We turn in a circle.
The eggs will catch on the weeds.
The water will carry them off.
We won't watch over them.
A brood like this is a great many fish.
A few survivors is enough.
We swim apart to feed.
My scales are a thin layer of silver.
Too small; it takes several mouthfuls.
This one has a bit of sand on it.
I nudge it with my snout, then eat.
It's floating. I come up for it.
I'm not picky about what falls in.
I draw it into my mouth.
That was so light I barely tasted it.
Done. I swim off.
There's more below. I'll look slowly.
Something landed on the water.
It's small, but I can see it.
I raise my head and rise.
From here it's one bite.
I turn sideways and point my spines at it.
There's nothing else in the water.
It sinks, and I sink with it.
I'll wait until it sinks to my level.
Now is exactly the right moment.

lines.zh: 六条腿的设计，还没走顺。
lines.en: Six-legged by design, and still unsteady.
I follow it for two circles.
It rises. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我嘴上那根长刺，先探到前面。
lines.en: The long spine on my snout probes ahead.
I watch that shadow.
The current brings it my way.
The six-legged ancestor's jaw has opened.
It hasn't noticed a thing.
I'm very close now.
My scales throw a flash.
It turned to look.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，很小的一口。
lines.en: I bite, a very small bite.
My tail strikes the surface.
That knocked it aside.
My spine pricked something.
It fled and I didn't chase.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，水花砸在它脸上。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and water hits its face.
I bite again and get nothing.
The water's cloudy and I can't see.
I sink and slip away.
This one I can't win.
A point of silver lights in the water.
I come out of the weeds.
The stream is shallow and I'm small.
First I test the water.
Light comes through the surface, warm.

lines.zh: 我的鳍上还挂着半片卵膜。
lines.en: Half an egg membrane still clings to my fin.
The bottom has stones and sand.
I swim a lap to learn the way.
A soft water sound upstream.
I head that way.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我只能往深处钻。
lines.en: The water's burning; I dive deep.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，鳞贴住石头。
lines.en: I'm flung ashore and my scales stick to stone.
The water's gone and my gills are open.
The blast turns the whole stream over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进水里，扎中我的鳍。
lines.en: An arrow comes into the water and finds my fin.

lines.zh: 一道光定住我，我一动不动。
lines.en: A light holds me still.

lines.zh: 水里什么都没有，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: Nothing in the water. Hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷落进溪里，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the stream and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的鳍在空里划。
lines.en: No water. My fins row at nothing.
